**PR title must start with one of:** `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`

Example: `feat: Add ledge grabbing`

> The **Validate PR Title** check rejects any pull request whose title does not follow this
> format, so set the title before you open the PR.

## Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced in this pull request.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Performance / Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation

## Related Issue(s)
Link the issue(s) resolved or impacted by this PR. E.g., "Fixes #12" or "Closes #45".

## Screenshot(s)
Attach screenshots showing off the change(s).
